notes.title: Update 32: Bodies, bodybags & Meds.
notes.content:
* Decomposing bodies and skeletons.

* Morgues and bodybag storage areas added to U.S. bases (and reward for finding M.I.A. bodies/skeletons and going to morgue or bodybag area to report the locations).

* New Medical sub-menu with 3 new options:

* Syringe will provide high temporary pain relief (health boost that fades away).

* Ketamoan pills have longer duration but less effect. Be careful not to overdose.

* Super glue spray available to treat wounds on other soldiers. Dextro Amplifier pills are now placed in this sub-menu instead of in rations.

* Player movement speed is now lowered as health declines. Use syringe or Ketamoan pills to temporarily negate this and get to safety.

* Angry monkeys fixed.

* Rabies dog added.

* Flashlight is now available outside of tunnels using “L” key (enemies will detect you way more easily). Flashlight will also be held more steady,

* Some bases updated (mess halls, generators, oil drums, vehicles etc.).

* Soldiers can now panic when wounded or low morale (player squad members will panic less if player has high leadership skill. The higher rank of NPC the less chance of panic. The type of the unit also plays a role. Panicked soldiers will get “!?!” over their head for the first 2 seconds).

* 6 new achievements and new 3 stats.

* Soldiers can now walk backwards (mostly when low morale or wounded or their squad is decimated).

* NPC firing accuracy with most main weapons has been significantly decreased during night time and reduced a little for daytime.

* Damage direction indicator will now stay on screen longer after being hit.

* When setting fire mode to single shot and then unequip or change to secondary weapon and then change back to rifle, it will no longer put rifle back to automatic firing mode.

* Start menu Load game button will now automatically update to the last faction played. Please note there are 2 save slots, 1 for each faction.

* Explosive force on player updated and clamped to prevent player sometimes being thrown to the moon or China etc.

* M577 MedEvac vehicle now has correct model set for main body when destroyed.

* Squad tactical scripts updated to reduce risk of bugs.

* If player selects fullscreen with borders, it should now display: Fullscreen: “Yes(Borders)” initially when starting game (instead of just: Fullscreen: “Yes”).

* Mi8 AI updated.

* Enemy weapon crates can now also be destroyed using hand grenades.

* Single use C4 will now be available for U.S. player when near tunnel entrance/exits, and when player of any faction is near certain infrastructure like big radio antennas.

* Airplanes will now drop more bombs on targets they spot themselves (ie. not on radio requested airstrikes).

* Missing war crime if U.S. player kills Vietnamese civilians with melee weapons has now been included.

* Blood effects when player use melee weapons updated.

* AB ground crews can no longer equip sunglasses etc.

* Land vehicles can no longer rotate after being destroyed.

* Saving captured bases as V.C. player has been updated to prevent bases taken in older save games affecting new save games.

* A U.S. guard tower that had metal rails preventing player to climb up, has been updated.

* Floating troops over guard towers fix attempt added.

* Issues with squad sub menu back function fixed.

* Giant centipedes fixed.

* Zu23 accuracy nerfed considerably vs AI aerial targets and slightly vs player air crafts.

* Medics sometimes running to heal player and getting stuck running towards him should now be fixed.

* Radiomen will now say voice line when they request airstrikes.

* Player can now swim 10% faster and rise in swimming skill much faster (and strength and stamina gain chance now too).

* There are now 50% more of the N.V.A. shock troops / sappers.


Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 31: Supply system. Artillery & Bug fixes.
notes.content:
Supply system:

* Both factions now have stats for supply % in province and nationwide (see Tab screen).

* The supply situation will affect troop spawns, vehicle respawn rates, artillery downtime between salvos, etc.

* V.C. supplies can be reduced by destroying bicycle troops (porters), trucks, various vehicles, boats, big supply crates etc..

* U.S. supplies can be reduced by destroying trucks, chinooks, various vehicles, ATC boats, oil drums, big supply crates, etc.

* Every day at noon, provincial supplies are replenished to a degree set by amount of nationwide supplies available. Half of V.C. replenished supplies are directly affected by the average loyalty of villages in the province.

* Porter squad has been added. When they complete a supply run to another base, it adds extra supplies to that province.

* New stats for destroyed supplies and achievements for 100 destroyed supplies.



Artillery, recoilless rifles and bug fixes:

* New M40 Recoilless Rifles on tripods have been added to U.S. and V.C. bases (Viet Cong stole some).

* M50 Ontos, M67 Recoilless Rifle (handheld one) and M274 Mule now fires more powerful recoilless rifle shells.

* New spawned V.C. base type: light artillery base (with recoilless rifles).

* U.S. squads should now be more proactive on the tactical level, and all squads should now reevaluate situation after being in combat or near player.

* Player commanding squads on map has been updated.

* In start menu, an issue where V.C. corps icon would blink from the start but you would start as N.V.A. unless clicking it, is now fixed.

* Machine guns on vehicles should now hopefully stop firing when vehicle is destroyed (incl. M113 and M48A3).

* Saving as V.C. player had issue that is now fixed (hopefully no more exist). Same fix will probably fix issues with some squads duplicating when loading game.

* A type of V.C. Guard tower which had wrong faction set on one of the scripts has now been fixed.

* Some guard towers updated in attempt to fix issue with troops stuck in the air over destroyed towers (more is needed).

* Some issues with special cigarette effect should now be fixed, and when using one, it will display how many left instead of just “-1”.

* Player can provide target coordinates for artillery when near them by looking at terrain and pressing “Q”.

* Artillery fired by player now has higher accuracy (less spread).

* Some U.S. M102 artillery can now use direct fire if not in an enclosed position and target is close enough. Also some more direct firing M102 have been placed.

* Player should now be able to use binoculars to request artillery support by pressing “Q”, if he is under 50m from radioman.

* Artillery should now be prevented from firing if crew exist but have recently died, or if all crew members are too far away.

* Replacement artillery soldiers will now be assigned to artillery units sometime after original crew has died.

* Destroyed artillery can now be repaired by player using wrench (placed in artillery emplacements) or welding tool, and they can be repaired automatically eventually.

* Artillery strikes requested by player should now be more accurate on the marker set on terrain.

* M107 (heavy) artillery strike changed so it should now be available in more areas, and bugs hopefully fixed now.

* More code added to prevent risk of game crashing when player operates artillery while it is destroyed.

* Missing field hospital added to Quang Ngai AB, and some bases updated with various structures and weapons and some terrains have been modified.

* Issue with overheating weapons not cooling down has been fixed (Mk18, 50cal).

* Artillery now has 20% longer ammo resupply breaks.

* Destroying some civilian vehicles now wont give XP and will instead give warcrimes+.

* Thuong Thoi SF camp on Cambodian border will now load properly.

* Some V.C. and ARVN bases that weren’t fully setup are now correctly set with region and province numbers, thus preventing bugs (incl. tab page when near them).

* Big centipede collider resize code fixed.

* Spawns at bases prevented when player of opposing faction is < 65m.

* Flag icons on villages in North Vietnam, no longer should have issues with either no icon, or them flipping to south,



Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 30: Aim high anim, mortar, traitor & music opt.
notes.content:
* Soldiers can now aim with arms in 45degree angle upwards to reduce the rotation of the whole body when firing at targets at a high angle.

* Soldiers now prevented from aiming in prone position at targets at a high angle.

* Player carried V.C. mortar is now able to be deployed.

* Traitor updated: As player reputation rises, so does the amount of reputation loss (in a few minutes) needed to become traitor.

* Player squad members now take 15% less damage from direct and indirect explosions.

* M1942 Machete is now rotated correctly in player's hand.

* More pre-placed destroyed vehicles and craters in DMZ region.

* Special cigarette box should now work as supply, and more boxes placed.

* Some structures now have more randomly activated stuff.

* Option added for radio broadcast music volume.

* Option added for non stop radio broadcast music (no random 6 or 12min pauses).

* AFVN Radio Station in Danang AB now has option to change music track, and speakers added there and at covered storage structures.


Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 29: Soldiers vs aircraft fix & trucks
notes.content: [p]* Soldiers targeting aircraft (ie not door gunners etc) can no longer enter a legacy aim high mode (that isn’t working correctly, but got activated unintentionally). I might fix the aim high mode and bring it back later though to reduce the amount soldiers rotate back to [b]hoot aircraft.  * All trucks now has 25% more gravity force.  * Flying trucks should now be fixed, or reduced a lot.  * Gaz69 on roads have been replaced by trucks with troops.   A quick update to mostly fix issue with soldiers shooting aircraft since update 27[/b]Thanks.[/p]

notes.title: Update 28: Player Movement
notes.content:
* Player forward movement now has more initial acceleration.

* Player backward movement now has more force and acceleration.

* Player strafing changed to hopefully feel more fluid and responsive.

* Player prone speed is reduced and re-enabling run mode while prone is now prevented.

* When spotting while flying aircraft since Update 27, it will no longer display incorrect “Airplane spotted” message every time “q” is pressed (it would however spot the target on crosshair correctly).


This is ofc not the final version of player movement, so feedback for it is still appreciated a lot, thanks.
Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 27: Movement, U.S. targeting aircraft, ZU23 nerf vs land units.
notes.content:
* Attempt to prevent player flying of hilltops and getting thrown far away from force of explosions (since movement was updated) has been added.

* Soldiers should now also be prevented from gaining unrealistic speeds sometimes right after climbing hills or obstacles.

* All soldiers should now be able to target all enemy airplanes and helicopters if they have appropriate weapon.

* U.S. Player can now spot aircraft for squad and nearby soldiers.

* All MG in land vehicles operated by AI should now stop firing if vehicle is destroyed.

* Machine gunners in vehicles have now been told not to shoot unarmed civilians.

* ZU23 nerfed vs ground units: now has reduced detection range, slower rate of fire 60% of the time, and is way less accurate.

* Swimming skill added (swim faster).

* Soldiers will no longer shoot at target dummies (I might bring it back in other form later).

* Player ability to XP farm the target dummies with helmets is now reduced.


Just a quick update to fix some pressing issues, thanks.
Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 26: Operations and bug fixes
notes.content:
* When loading captured bases, flag pole should now update too.

* When taking enemy bases, the defensive structures will now also change faction and spawn defenders (same as when loading game with captured bases after Update 25.

* Defensive structures can now spawn more soldiers to replace dead ones (unless they’ve been destroyed).

* When loading game, soldiers spawning in bases and not part of a squad will now spawn a few seconds later so bases captured has time to load first.

* Soldiers now have slightly reduced close quarter alertness/detection.

* Player forward movement speed very slightly reduced.

* BTR60 and M113 should no longer be able to fire MG after being destroyed.

* Danang AB updated (shooting range, obstacle course, mess hall, base radio in HQ, hidden Stoner63, L1A1, more field manuals & special items etc.)

* Airplane 20mm MG now projectile now fires at realistic muzzle velocity (incl. A-1 Skyraider).

* Typo in start menu fixed (Harcore >> Hardcore).

* B52 airstrikes will now “only” drop 3 x 48 bombs instead of 3 x 96 (for better performance)

* Some terrains in Cambodia incorrectly tagged are now fixed (troops couldn’t run up hills properly there etc).

* Land vehicles now use 33% less fuel.

* Big and giant snake size reduced, and they are now more rare.

* More bulldozers added.

* Mortar UI stuck on screen when dying near mortar fixed.

* Mainland scene etc. have been updated to hopefully fix issues with weapons firing there.

* Code added in attempt to prevent crashes while playing as V.C.

* Achievement for taking Victory Points as V.C. player has now been fixed (to unlock at 40).

* When a commanding officer of a base dies, he will now be replaced in a few minutes (in preparation for coming operations they will trigger).

* Commanders will now spawn and be assigned to all base types except LZ, Outpost & POW camps.



Operations:

* Operation info page added (F9), and key hint for it under the normal mission UI.

* New Stat for operations completed and new achievement for 10 completed.

* All U.S. Operations (excl. naval Ops) are available to play as V.C. player on the defensive (U.S. plan of attack shown on map. Op is completed when main objective base has been defended long enough). To start them, find a commander nearby, they are marked “Op” on the map.



* “Operation Marauder” now has briefing text, press F9 while Op is active. To start: talk to the commanding officer in Hiep Hoa SF Camp.

* Operation: “Battle of Long Tan” added. To start it; go to any Australian base and talk to a commander.

* “Operation Hastings” added. To start; talk to the commander of The Rockpile FOB (or a base near it) in DMZ area.

* Operation: “Battle of La Drang Valley” added. To start: talk to the commander of FSB Falcon south west of Pleiku.

* “Operation Thor” added. To start: talk to the commander at a base in the eastern DMZ area.

* “Operation Junction City” added. To start: talk to the commander of SF base north of Tay Ninh.

* “Operation Inferno” added. To start: talk to the commander in a base near U Minh Forest (Mekong region).

* “Operation Matador” added. To start: talk to the commander at FSB Gypsy.

* “Operation Utah” added. To start: talk to the commander of Quang Ngai AB.

* “Operation Nha Trang” added. To start: talk to the commander of Nha Trang AB.

* “Operation Crockett” added. To start: talk to the commander of Khe Sanh.

* “Operation Lam Son 719” added. To start, complete Op Crockett and talk to the  commander of Khe Sanh again.

* “Operation Game Warden” added. To start, talk to commander in Vinh Long Naval Base.

* Covert Operation in Cambodia added.

* Air Force test Ops added on carriers.



V.C. offensive operations:

* “Operation A Shau” added. To start: talk to the commander at the N.V.A. base near A Shau Valley.

* “Operation Holloway” added. To start: talk to commander in V.C base south of Pleiku.

* “Operation Da Nang” added. To start: talk to commander in V.C. rocket base west of Danang AB.

* “Operation Can Tho” added. To start: talk to commander in V.C. base south-west of Binh Thuy AB in Can Tho.

* “Operation Phan Rang” added. To start: talk to commander in V.C. base north west of Phan Rang AB.

* “Operation Bearcat” added. To start: talk to commander in V.C. base east of Bearcat basecamp.


Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 25: CQC, base save/load, armories, chaplains, options & bug fixes.
notes.content:
* Close quarter combat updated.

* Base capture save / load updated (base icons now display correct faction in loaded games, and soldiers in fortifications around base are correct faction so base doesn’t flip back right away).

* New tent armories added for U.S. faction.

* Chaplain NPC (Faith+ MentalHealth+) and new tent chapels added, and existing chapels updated.

* Big and giant snakes and centipedes now exist, and big spiders that do damage.

* New NPC reporters in civilian outfit now spawn at bases.

* More Mk18 grenade launchers and generators (to recharge radio) added.

* Base select in start menu now shows arrows in QHD resolution (only allowed for some corps choices).

* Issue on QHD resolution where skill gains wasn’t shown is now fixed.

* Option for Invert infantry Y axis added to start menu.

* Option for less animals added to start menu (for better performance).

* Options for auto-save added to start menu settings (off, 5, 10, 20, 30, 60 minutes), default is 30mins.

* Line of sight check while prone updated for NPCs.

* Decrease of how often NPCs go prone in certain situations.

* Player can no longer enter running mode while prone.

* Player prone speed increased.

* Player now gets more force if moving slow when going up steep hills.

* Player will now get up if crouching or prone when water reaches swimming depth, and he can’t crouch now while swimming.

* Player’s character icon is now the correct corps type when loading game.

* Issue where player would pick up a radio and it would instantly call for reinforcements is now fixed.

* Player can no longer have squad radio and main weapon equipped at same time.

* Having squad radio equipped will now longer display “Drop weapon” UI hint.

* U.S. soldiers will no longer attack civilian Vietcong loyalists with hidden weapon until they disclose it.

* Helicopter MG will now reload for 8 seconds when mag is empty.

* Helicopters now use 25% less fuel.

* Recoilless M67 projectiles now give more damage (M50 Ontos and handheld).

* MP dogs should no longer push the MPs around.

* MP dogs spawn lower.

* Less snakes now spawn in the air.

* U.S. Air traffic control towers no longer has V.C. / N.V.A soldiers.

* Land vehicles and aircraft will no longer attack POWs (incl. player when POW).

* Achievements for all Victory Points taken should now work.

* Voice of player now won’t read 6 base attack mission texts in a row.


Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 24: Combat AI, new NPCs & improvements.
notes.content:
* Combat AI improved.

* M72 LAW NPC soldiers added.

* M40 NPC snipers added.

* Reporter NPC added (+rep if in his FOV, if filmed: +rep, w. crimes x 4).

* VC/NVA mission structure has now been changed to be as intended (way less rice tax missions).

* M151A2 and Gaz69 jeeps can now roadkill people.

* When spotting for squad or soldiers, they will now check if any friendlies are in line of fire before shooting.

* Player will now auto exit land vehicles when they’re destroyed. Thus also preventing possible game crashes.

* Player squad auto-follow at the start of the game now won’t affect pilot classes.

* Most weapon crates with secondary weapons should now be able to supply squad members.

* Detection scripts optimized for better performance.

* NPC snipers updated (they can shoot more often now).

* The player's momentum before death will no longer be kept when respawning.

* Issues with display of corps names for Pilot classes fixed.

* Prevented equipment change for Bird Dog aircraft (caused crashes).

* Fix added to ensure RPG soldier reload time isn’t affected by changed in Update 23.

* Dog attack run speed decreased, more gravity added.

* M202 FLASH repositioned in hand of NPC when given by player. Initial force on it now same as when player fires it.

* Player now can’t enter vehicles while dead.


Thank you beta testers

notes.title: Update 23: M79 soldier fix
notes.content:
* Issue with M79 soldiers often preventing them from firing is now fixed.

* Soldiers will now aim faster in some situations.

* Player squad will now follow player automatically from start of game.

* Potential issue with ammo crates in mainland after Update 22 fixed.

notes.title: Update 22: Squad weapons & Entrench tool: destroy
notes.content:
* Player can now give most main and secondary weapons to his squad members (while having the weapon in your hands, look at the soldier and press “u”. Changes to squad loadout won’t be saved after exiting the game).

* Weapon crates now offer the possibility to provide weapons to your squad members (press “u” once per squad member you want to equip).

* Structures built by the player can now be destroyed using the entrench tool (and 90% of the supplies are returned to the player and squad members near).

* Map Icon now shows the distance to your mission target.

* The amount of squad reinforcements bases get over time is now reduced, and a bit less random (as this will improve performance, especially after game has been running a while).

* Fix added for issues with the interior camera FOV on M48A3 and M113.

* Letter Icon (legacy stuff) on Radio UI now removed (this time for real, sorry).

* More gravity on dogs and snakes.


Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 21: Squad UI
notes.content:
* Squad UI now shows if soldiers are on Follow, Moving or in Combat.

* Dog UI now disappears when squad UI is open.

notes.title: Update 20: Squad improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
* Player's squad members should now find their way a lot faster if stuck.

* Player’s squad members will now follow player again after combat.

* New recruits and squad members returning from hospital will now go to nearest base (instead of to player's main base).

* A1-Skyraider cockpit fixed, and the MG bullets now have way higher velocity.

* Chinook cockpit/aim view updated.

* F5 Tiger II cockpit view adjusted.

* Names for female American civilians now updated.

* Hitting parked enemy aircraft now gives less XP and they can’t be farmed for XP after being destroyed.

* Unused Icon in radio UI menu is now removed.

* Periodic squad “Name Name” errors should now hopefully be fixed.

* M151 Jeep and Gaz-69 jeep double interior issue fixed (interior cam FOV issue). Same fix will be extended to the M113 and M48 in the next soon.

* Player prone speed increased.

* Attempt to prevent possible crash after completed rice mission added.

* Corps name display in loaded games should now be fixed.


Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 19: Medics, improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
* “Going Home?” signs and offices added to larger bases (fast travel to Saigon Int. Airport if tour of service completed).

* Hospital admissions in U.S.A. will now last longer, thus summer comes faster.

* U.S. Medics now have a medic icon on their helmet and armband.

* Handheld radio battery no longer decrease when using carried squad radio.

* Chinook supply/vehicle drops should now land near the player properly, and chinook take off again (PBR drop still needs fix).

* Disabling radio broadcast music from in-game settings now works.

* Missile base added to Coloradaho (work in progress).

* Village UI typo fixed.

* Player run speed slightly reduced.

* Player Squad command range increased to 30m

* Icons for Sa-7, DP-27 and Mosin Nagant fixed (corners removed).

* VC player no longer say incorrect voice lines when killing friendlies sometimes.

* VC soldiers no longer say incorrect voice lines to player when killing friendlies sometimes.


Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 18: Bug fixes
notes.content:
* Player can now climb hills and steep ramps faster.

* Infinite dig sound after building tunnel fixed.

* Binoculars for U.S. player now fixed (cloud cam issue).

* Animals should now stop animating when they die (not small birds yet).

* Dog tags can no longer be picked up while in a vehicle.

* U.S. Radiomen will now drop radio when killed.


Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 17: Rocket update and improvements
notes.content:
* RPG-2, RPG-7, M72 LAW, SA-7 and aircraft rockets (Hydra 70) and air to air missiles:
Rocket motor visual effects updated.

* SA-7 (anti air missile MANPADS for VC/NVA) now works for player.

* SA-7 model + UI updated and buzzer sound added when a target is locked.

* NVA SA-7 soldiers will now drop SA-7 when killed.

* Air to air missiles should now be fired against Mi8, and Mi8 are more rare now.

* Air to air missile kills by player should now give XP.

* M67 Recoilless Rifle aiming has been improved for the player.

* Hydra70 rocket model updated.

* Player walk speed reduced a bit more.

* Player prone speed increased.

* Player swimming updated.

* Dog anti-gravity reduced.


Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 16: Flight Control options
notes.content:
* Controls for aircraft yaw and roll can now be switched in settings; so yaw is mouse X axis, and roll is A and D.

* Invert flight Y axis now actually works (sorry guys), and option now added to ingame settings menu.

* Hardcore mode setting should now display correctly on startup what was last selected.

notes.title: Update 15: Improvements
notes.content:
* Movement updated (slower walk speed).

* Player will now run faster when on Dextro Amplifier pills (instead of only being able to run without getting tired).

* Bug fixed when VC player selects structure to build in build menu.

* Dragging map with mouse should now work on screens with touch too, and perhaps in other cases.

* Players can now command squad from further away (now 20m, press F1 twice to make squad follow).

* When player revive at U.S. field hospital, squad should now spawn outside tent.

* Start menu buttons rearranged and beta warning added to Corps button.

* Saved dog should now be deleted when starting new game.

* Bug fixed where playing hardcore and then loading game would give random player start position.

* If player is sent to field hospital in a base taken by enemy he will now become a P.O.W.

* Field hospitals built by player now allow respawn there.

* Squad medic icon is now correct colors.


Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 14: Hardcore Mode (beta) and bug fixes
notes.content:
* Hardcore Mode (beta: instead of going to the field hospital it’s a gameover and sends you back to the main menu. You do not get a compass, there is death from dehydration and no save/load available. More to come soon, incl. some more compassion with gameover risk).

* USA scenes updated so new additions shouldn’t give bugs.

* Save / load of friendly bases taken by enemy.

* Start menu changed so as to be less confusing.

* Fixed a specific skill gain to only come near civilians.

notes.title: Update 13: Player Movement, improvements, dog stuff.
notes.content:
* Player movement updated (less ice skating, more acceleration, no slide off of hills, running boosted etc). This isn't the final iteration of player movement, so please give feedback. Thank you!

* Squad on follow should now look around when not moving, instead of always looking at player.

* NPC soldiers ability to spot enemies at close range improved.

* Janky Bar (chocolate) added to rations sub-menu and supply boxes added.

* Affirmative or Negative audio replies added for radio requests.

* Bonfire now can set fire to humans and player. Now decays after 4+1 mins.

* Player swimming speed reduced.

* Slightly more females are now secretly Vietcong.

* Dog save / load.

* Dog of VC/NVA player now gets the NVA pith helmet.

* Dog treats added.

* Dog house bunkers added to the rest of the bigger U.S. bases.

* Dog UI hint when hungry.

* New skills added.


Thank you beta testers!!

notes.title: Update 12: Dog interactions + stats. More bug fixes
notes.content:
* Dog Interactions added (look at dog +LMB.  Requires over 10 loyalty):

* Pet, feed (raw meat or rations) and reprimand.

* Dog stats with effects added (courage, strength, combat, intelligence.), thus making every dog unique. Some stats may decrease if dog is starving.

* Dog combat updated for damage and new dog stats. Dog may now flee and hesitate to attack etc.

* Dog house bunkers added to DMZ region (Quang Tri, Hue, Danang etc).

* Bullets won’t bounce off of dogs anymore (although doing damage).

* Checking civilian papers now works (look at civilian, click LMB while having no weapon equipped).

* Changing Corps button from in-game menu, now has beta warning (as it has not been tested enough and seems to cause issues).

* Repair XP farming stopped.

* Army icon in start menu corps select now pulsates like rest.


Thank you beta testers!
Dogs won't be saved yet sorry, hopefully soon though. Thank you

notes.title: Dogs (experimental) and more bug fixes.
notes.content:
* Stay near dog to gain loyalty (10 needed).

* Military Police now has guard dogs.

* Street dogs.

* Fuel is now refilled at land-vehicle repair pads.

* Alpha monkeys are now more aggressive, and will spawn more often but in smaller numbers.

* Game manual in rations sub-menu now contains tips.

* Scorched ground terrain settings now work,

* Dog tags now can only be taken once.

* Long Tieng base in Laos updated.

* Issues with inventory etc. after reaching high rank quick fixed.



I will improve dogs and add more interactions soon. 

Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 10: Traitor / MP update
notes.content:
Traitor mechanic updated:

You will become a traitor if reputation reaches -3 or below, or falls 3 or more in a few minutes. 
It won't forever though.

Now you will get negative reputation for every friendly shot at close range.
However at long range there is chance for no loss of reputation.

While flying and shooting MG it carries a 33% risk of negative rep.
While driving landvehicle and shooting MG it carries a 50% risk of negative reputation.
Explosive damage weapons also has reduced risk, especially if in vehicles.

MPs will now serve justice if you get out of line (more to come soon).


Thank you beta testers!

notes.title: Update 9: Traitor and bug fixes
notes.content:
* Player can now become a traitor (keep an eye on your reputation).

* Close quarter combat updated.

* Victory Points switching when saving fixed.

* Binoculars cloud-camera misalignment fixed.

* Binoculars key (b) added to keymap.

* Zoom in/out (MMB) added to keymap for Infantry and Aircraft.

notes.title: Update 8: Medic colors changed
notes.content: Medic and field hospital icon colors have now been changed to white on red.

notes.title: Update 5: Squad improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
* “Call Squad to this Base”, added to U.S. Base Radios.

* Player squad members will now engage enemies further away.

* Player Squad members are now better at detecting enemies.

* Player Squad members now run faster on follow if falling behind.

* Player Squad members now have some health regeneration.

* Bombsight will now disable when dying or exiting planes while using it.

* VC Player Squad will now fast travel along player.

* VC fast travel limited to once per 10 min.

* Skycrane is now more agile.

* SA2 missiles have decreased max turn rate.

* The game no longer crashes when dying while operating artillery (should also work for other 
   situations where audio nuke bug happens).

* Squad radio operator and medic can now be called using both command menu and chat even after 
   they die and are replaced by a new recruit.

Thanks beta testers!
